question: Can the minimal execution_ready semantic, independent of residency/acquisition, remain coherent under transitional and adversarial states while preserving all 114,688 family #1 decisions, the bounded P8 oracle, and the I002 direct-execution oracle, without requiring an activation enum/state machine or family-specific policy branch?

minimal_hypothesis.activation_state: one boolean execution_ready per routable primitive
minimal_hypothesis.execution_available: executor/path exists and is available in principle
minimal_hypothesis.acquisition_startability: existing AcquisitionRuntimeState.available/vetoed determines whether a new acquisition may be initiated now

precedence_rules: Lifecycle invalidation of a resident represented primitive takes precedence over routing readiness.
A primitive may be routed only when execution_ready and execution_available are both true.
A primitive requiring residency may not route unless resident, identity-valid and lease-valid.
A resident but temporarily not-ready representation is retained unless an established lifecycle eviction condition fires.
Readiness alone does not trigger acquisition; acquisition remains descriptor-driven.
An acquisition already in progress or presently not startable is represented as unavailable to start now, preventing duplicate acquisition issuance.
A fallback is not assumed universally ready; explicit fallback runtime state may make it unroutable.
For the frozen first-family compatibility surface, legacy A is mapped ready and B execution_ready is derived from resident plus execution availability, adding no new decision dimension.
adversarial_obligations: family #1 resident B plus readiness revoked routes ready A while preserving valid B
family #1 resident B plus readiness revoked plus A not ready returns NOT_READY with no route and preserves valid B
family #1 acquisition not startable causes no duplicate ACQUIRE
P8 absent plus acquisition startable performs mandatory ACQUIRE independent of reuse
P8 absent plus acquisition not startable returns NOT_READY with no duplicate ACQUIRE
P8 resident valid plus readiness revoked returns NOT_READY while preserving representation
P8 identity or lease invalidation causes EVICT regardless of readiness
I002 direct temporarily unavailable or not ready routes ready baseline fallback
I002 direct ready with resident false routes preferred direct primitive
I002 direct not ready plus baseline not ready returns NOT_READY with no route
outside-evidence behavior remains bounded for P8 and I002
pass_rule: All obligations pass with one execution_ready boolean and existing acquisition startability, with zero family-specific branches and no activation enum/state machine.
